mapper.select: SELECT MOVIE_ID AS "movieId", TITLE AS "title", FIRST_RELEASE_DATE AS "firstReleaseDate", SCREENING_START_DATE AS "screeningStartDate", SCREENING_END_DATE AS "screeningEndDate", REG_ID AS "regId", REG_DT AS "regDt", MOD_ID AS "modId", MOD_DT AS "modDt" FROM MOVIE ORDER BY REG_DT DESC, MOVIE_ID DESC
